summary: Iteration 5 retest of the Instagram (Composio) posting bug fix. 20/22 pytest tests PASS — the iteration-4 datetime tz bug is FULLY fixed (5 public-image-route tests cover ISO-string future, ISO-string past=410, legacy tz-naive future, legacy tz-naive expired, and unknown-id=404). The Instagram endpoint now correctly returns HTTP 200 + {success:false, platform, error:...} JSON through the public edge (no more <!DOCTYPE html> rewrite). HOWEVER, a NEW CRITICAL regression was introduced in the SAME fix: server.py:1315 (LinkedIn URN exception handler) calls `_humanize_provider_error(...)` which is defined as a nested function LATER in the same `social_post` body (line 1353). Python binds the name as a local in the enclosing function, so calling it before its `def` is reached raises `UnboundLocalError: cannot access local variable '_humanize_provider_error' where it is not associated with a value` → FastAPI returns bare HTTP 500 + Content-Type text/plain 'Internal Server Error' (no JSON body at all). Verified via direct curl to https://rep-daily-ai.preview.emergentagent.com/api/social/linkedin/post — returns 500 text/plain. This is WORSE than iteration 4 because the user now sees a literal 'Internal Server Error' string and the edge still rewrites HTML (5xx). The Instagram path happens to avoid the bug only because its identical except-handler path at line 1408-1411 runs AFTER the nested def is reached. Other regression checks PASS: /api/scheduled round-trip with platforms:['instagram'], /api/social/{platform}/status and /accounts return 200 JSON (no HTML), data:URI as image_url is decoded+hosted, public_images docs now store expires_at as ISO string per the fix.

critical.issue: NEW REGRESSION in iteration 5 fix. Returns HTTP 500 with Content-Type text/plain body 'Internal Server Error' (no JSON envelope at all). Root cause: server.py:1315 calls `_humanize_provider_error(e, platform)` from the LinkedIn URN `except Exception` handler, but `_humanize_provider_error` is defined as a NESTED `def` at server.py:1353 — i.e., LATER in the same `social_post` function. Python flags it as a local variable in the enclosing scope, so accessing it before its def executes raises `UnboundLocalError`. FastAPI then returns its default 500 text/plain. Confirmed via backend stack trace AND direct public-URL curl. FIX: Move `_humanize_provider_error` OUT of `social_post` to module scope (cleanest), OR move the `def` to the very top of `social_post` BEFORE the LinkedIn branch. The 200+success:false envelope is otherwise correct (verified working for Instagram via the same code path).

minor.issue: Pre-existing logic quirk (NOT introduced in iteration 5): with a brand-new random user_id (no connected accounts), the endpoint returns `{connected: true, connection_id: null}`. Root cause server.py:1219 `items = getattr(result, 'items', None) or list(result or [])` — when result.items is an empty list `[]` (falsy), it falls through to `list(result)` which iterates the SDK response object and yields truthy entries. Should be `items = getattr(result, 'items', []) if hasattr(result, 'items') else list(result or [])`. Surfaced incidentally; out of scope for this iteration but worth flagging.
Endpoint exists for all 3 platforms (returns 200 JSON). Not part of iteration-5 fix scope but verified functional as a regression check.
Confirmed FIXED — expires_at is now stored as an ISO string (verified by reading back from MongoDB after a live POST). created_at also stored as ISO string. Good.

integration_issues.issue: Frontend `api.socialPost` (per the fix description) now throws when `res.success === false`. But because the backend currently returns HTTP 500 + text/plain (not JSON, not 200+success:false), the frontend's JSON parse will fail / throw a generic '500' error to the user. End-to-end LinkedIn posting is still broken at the user-facing layer until the UnboundLocalError above is fixed.

rca_of_issue: REPRODUCTION: `curl -X POST https://rep-daily-ai.preview.emergentagent.com/api/social/linkedin/post -H 'X-User-Id: be-rca-1' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"content":"rca probe"}'` → HTTP 500 + Content-Type `text/plain; charset=utf-8` + body `Internal Server Error`. Backend stack trace pinpoints `/app/backend/server.py:1315: UnboundLocalError: cannot access local variable '_humanize_provider_error' where it is not associated with a value`. ROOT CAUSE: In iteration 5 the dev added two new returns in the `social_post` function — `return {'success': False, ..., 'error': _humanize_provider_error(...)}` — at lines 1315 (LinkedIn URN exception) and 1408-1411 (main provider failure). The latter works because by line 1408 the nested `def _humanize_provider_error` at line 1353 has executed and bound the name; the former at line 1315 fires BEFORE line 1353 ever runs, so the name is unbound (Python sees it as a local because of the later def, but the def hasn't been reached yet). The Instagram path doesn't hit this code path on URN failure (LinkedIn-specific branch), which is why Instagram tests pass and LinkedIn tests fail. MITIGATION: Hoist `_humanize_provider_error` to module scope (cleanest — it has no closures over local state and is reusable by the scheduler code). One-line move of the def block (lines 1353-1378) to above the `social_post` decorator (~line 1268). After that, both failing tests should pass without further code changes. The iteration-4 datetime tz fix and the 200+success:false envelope shape are correct — the only remaining defect is this scoping bug in the helper placement.
